label: relA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the relA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor relA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 949 to 1,028 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying relA once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.32 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 29,024 calls, named 96%, 0.14 bits; shell 13,740 calls, named 84%, 0.64 bits; cloud 356 calls, named 31%, 2.67 bits. Outside an RGP 30,449 calls, named 95%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 12,671 calls, named 85%, 0.68 bits. Columns: 42 spine, 19 fork, 19 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.68 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (85% against 95%); 12,671 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 6 (ygcG, a fork column) 1.86 bits, RGP 91%; column 24 ("IS4-like element IS421 family transposa…", a fork column) 1.18 bits, RGP 59%; column 9 (ygcE, a variable column) 1.05 bits, RGP 92%. The 21 columns (columns 6-16, 23-28 and 44-47) where most calls are in an RGP: named 87%, 0.59 bits on average; the other 59 columns: named 94%, 0.22 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 42 spine columns: named 93%, 0.23 bits on average; the 38 fork and variable columns: named 91%, 0.42 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 6, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 8 (spine), RGP 92%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: relA. named 100%; 0.05 bits.
